messages:
Aisha: quick heads-up after today's QA pass — the settings modal on dashboard feels tight. the top padding looks like `space-2` but body uses `space-4`. close icon hit target is tiny on mobile (hard to tap). screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/settings-modal-tight.png
Tom: saw that too. i think we accidentally dropped `component-padding: space-4` when we swapped token aliases. propose a `modal-breath` token to express visual breathing room (values: 'compact' = 12px, 'regular' = 20px). will that cover forms and small settings panels?
Riya: +1 for `modal-breath`. accessibility wise, close icon needs a 44px target. let's keep the visible icon at 24px but increase padding. also recommend adding `aria-label="Close settings"` and ensure it's announced as a button by screen readers.
Ben: toasts are another problem — their enter animation overlaps the CTA in the modal and sometimes traps pointer events for a fraction of a second. current css: `pointer-events: auto` on animation. maybe switch to `pointer-events: none` until animation end, or animate `transform` + `opacity` only. also, on mobile the toast covers the bottom action row. thoughts on anchoring?
Aisha: design preference: toasts should not be inside modal stacking context. prefer global toast portal anchored top-right on desktop, bottom-center on mobile with safe offset from fixed footers. we used to have `--toast-surface-offset: 64px` for header avoidance — could reuse that.
Tom: implementation plan: add `portal: true` to toast API and a `mountNode` fallback to `document.body`. also expose `toast.avoidSelectors` for edge cases (e.g., `.floating-action-bar`). will add a test to assert toasts are outside `.modal` in the DOM.
Riya: motion/accessibility: respect `prefers-reduced-motion` — for those users, toasts should instantly appear with no translate animation and reduced timing. also reduce animation duration to 120ms for keyboard-triggered actions so it feels snappy but not jarring.
Ben: microcopy note: primary action in the modal currently says "Confirm". context is updating billing settings — propose "Update billing" for clarity. also, toast should say "Billing updated" rather than generic "Success". small change but improves feedback loop.
Aisha: agree on copy. please ensure the primary button label is mirrored exactly in the toast so users see consistent language.
DesignBot: design token PR queued: adds `modal-breath-compact` and `modal-breath-regular`, updates button hit target util, and toast portal boolean. visual diff snapshot id: 9f7b2c.
Tom: i'll open the PR and include the CSS fallback for increased hit area (padding + negative margin) so layout doesn't shift. code snippet i'll use:
```
.icon-close { padding: 10px; margin: -10px; width: 24px; height: 24px; }
```
That keeps visual size the same but touch target grows.
Riya: i'll do an a11y pass after the PR — keyboard order, role/labels, reduced motion handling. please add a changelog note so product knows copy updated.
Ben: small follow-up: ensure toast dismissal is reachable via keyboard (focusable) but default auto-dismiss should not steal focus. when a user is inside a modal, focus must remain in the modal until it's closed.
Aisha: perfect. let's aim to land the token + portal change in the next sprint. thanks all :sparkles:
